relations.rationale: Tess arranging pieces and checking the board is unrelated to the advisor's brief visit to check attendance.
Xavi driving the minibus doesn't establish anything about the smoothness of the trip from the other campus.
Claim 7 directly asserts Xavi drove the minibus, which directly contradicts claim 18 that he did not.
Xavi driving the minibus has no bearing on the advisor leaving scoresheets on a table.
A smooth trip suggests traffic wasn't a problem, which slightly undercuts the general claim about unpredictable traffic at that hour, though the general claim could still be true.
The smoothness of the trip has no logical connection to who drove the minibus.
The smoothness of the earlier trip has no bearing on whether games were unfinished by session's end.
Traffic unpredictability near a roundabout is unrelated to Xavi's height helping him reach shelves.
Traffic conditions have no bearing on whether chess games were finished by session's end.
Ivo being older than Jude does not imply anything about arrival order.
Ivo's age relative to Jude is unrelated to Xavi's height relative to younger members.
Ivo choosing a seat near the radiator supports the idea that he feels the cold more than others.
Ivo feeling cold more than others is unrelated to newer members' confusion about the rating system.
Ivo's sensitivity to cold has no bearing on Xavi's height helping him reach shelves.
Ivo's cold sensitivity is unrelated to Nell's promise about scheduling a meeting.
Tess arriving before Ivo doesn't determine the order between Ivo and Jude.
Tess's arrival time relative to Ivo has no bearing on the advisor leaving scoresheets.
Tess's arrival order is unrelated to Xavi's height and shelf access.
Tess arriving before Ivo does not necessarily imply she arrived before Jude, since Ivo and Jude's order is unspecified in this pair.
Jude's week of practicing openings supports the idea that he'd be eager to try a new variation against an unfamiliar opponent.
